panama_canal.name: Panama Canal (Miraflores Locks)
panama_canal.price_text: Entry fee for the visitor centre; check on the day
panama_canal.hours: Daily, roughly 08:00–17:00 · check on the day
panama_canal.tip: Ships pass mostly in the morning; check the day's transit schedule before you go.

casco_viejo.name: Casco Viejo (Old Quarter)
casco_viejo.tip: Walk the plazas and sea wall in the late afternoon, then stay for dinner.

panama_viejo.name: Panama Viejo (Old Panama ruins)
panama_viejo.price_text: Small entry fee; check on the day
panama_viejo.hours: Daily daytime hours · check on the day
panama_viejo.tip: Bring sun protection; the ruins are open and hot with little shade.

biomuseo.name: BioMuseo
biomuseo.price_text: Entry fee; check on the day
biomuseo.hours: Closed Mondays typically · check on the day
biomuseo.tip: The building by Frank Gehry is as much the draw as the exhibits; allow time for the outdoor walk.

bridge_americas.name: Bridge of the Americas
bridge_americas.tip: Best seen from the Amador Causeway at sunset rather than driven across.

ff_tower.name: F&F Tower
ff_tower.tip: A quick photo stop; the twisting tower is best framed from a few blocks away.

metropolitan_cathedral.name: Metropolitan Cathedral of Panama
metropolitan_cathedral.hours: Open daily, hours vary · check on the day
metropolitan_cathedral.tip: Step inside for the stone interior; dress modestly.

san_jose_church.name: San Jose Church (Golden Altar)
san_jose_church.hours: Open daily, hours vary · check on the day
san_jose_church.tip: The gilded altar is the highlight; visit quietly during services.

sancocho.name: Sancocho (traditional chicken stew)
sancocho.price_text: Varies by restaurant; budget to mid-range
sancocho.hours: Lunch and dinner at most local restaurants
sancocho.tip: Try it at a fonda or market eatery for the most authentic version.

mercadito.name: Mercado de Mariscos (Seafood Market)
mercadito.price_text: Pay per dish; cheap to mid-range
mercadito.hours: Daytime, closes by late afternoon · check on the day
mercadito.tip: Eat at the upstairs ceviche counters for fresh, cheap seafood.

amador_causeway.name: Amador Causeway walk
amador_causeway.price_text: Free to walk; bike rental extra
amador_causeway.tip: Rent a bike and ride to the causeway end for skyline and canal views.

ankon_hill.name: Ancon Hill viewpoint
ankon_hill.hours: Daytime only · check on the day
ankon_hill.tip: Walk up early for city and canal views; go with others and avoid dusk.

cinta_costera.name: Cinta Costera waterfront
cinta_costera.tip: Walk or jog the waterfront path for skyline views; lively in the evening.

el_cangrejo_walk.name: El Cangrejo neighbourhood walk
el_cangrejo_walk.tip: Good area for cafes and restaurants; wander in the evening.

canal_partial_transit.name: Partial canal transit boat tour
canal_partial_transit.price_text: Tour price varies; check on the day
canal_partial_transit.hours: Departs mornings · check on the day
canal_partial_transit.tip: Book ahead in high season; confirm pickup and what is included.

casco_food_walk.name: Casco Viejo food and history walk
casco_food_walk.price_text: Tour price varies; check on the day
casco_food_walk.hours: Usually evening departures · check on the day
casco_food_walk.tip: A guided walk covers history and local food in one go; book a day ahead.
